title: ビジネスアナリティックス
subtitle: Data Analytics for Business
educationalGoal: This course provides the principles and practices of basic methods of data science. Students learn data aggregation, regression analysis, cluster analysis, decision tree analysis, and artificial neural networks, which are the basis of recent deep learning. Students also learn two types of data science tools: KNIME and Python with visual operations.
advice: In recent years, mathematics, AI, and data science have attracted a great deal of attention of various fields. This course is especially designed for the students who have learned basic statistics. Students learn data aggregation, which is a first-step method of data science, and then learn typical data science techniques such as regression analysis, cluster analysis, decision tree analysis, artificial neural networks. This course provides both classroom lectures and hands-on analysis exercises with KNIME and Python that are useful and use freeware tools for data analysis. Students learn theories, analytical skills, and some examples of business intelligence, which is considered to be the use of data in actual business. The instructor expect students to acquire the ability of data analysis trough this class to develop business in the future.
books: Textbooks: Data Sceience nyuumon, Asakura Shoten (ISBN-9784254129113) (in Japanese language) Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Students are required to bring their own laptop computer to each class. The laptop PC needs to be able to install KNIME and Python with connecting to the Internet. Students are expected to understand basics of statistics and Python programming, so the instructor strongly recommend to take three courses, "Statistics I", "Statistics II", and "Algorithms and Data Structures" before taking this course.
